description: This file contains utility functions for resolving and spawning external pnpm processes, especially handling cross-platform command execution, including Windows-specific behavior.

methods.name: isPnpmExecPath
methods.description: Checks if the provided path corresponds to a pnpm executable, considering various filename extensions.

methods.name: escapeForCmdExe
methods.description: Escapes a command line argument for safe inclusion in Windows cmd.exe, throwing an error if unsafe characters are detected.

methods.name: buildCmdExeCommandLine
methods.description: Builds a Windows command line string with properly escaped arguments.

methods.name: resolvePnpmRunner
methods.description: Resolves the command and arguments needed to run pnpm, handling platform-specific cases and environment variables.

methods.name: createPnpmRunnerSpawnSpec
methods.description: Creates the spawn specification (command, args, options) for spawning the pnpm process.

methods.name: spawnPnpmRunner
methods.description: Spawns a pnpm process using the resolved command and arguments.
